newsitem.title: UK: LucasVarity buys U.S. car component firm.
newsitem.headline: LucasVarity buys U.S. car component firm.

text.p: Automotive and aerospace group LucasVarity Plc said on Monday it had bought privately held California-based car components manufacturer known as Autospecialty, which had a net asset value of about 20 million stg.

Autospecialty, based in Torrance, California, is a leader in producing and supplying braking and clutch undercar products covering virtually all domestic and imported light vehicles in service in the U.S. and Canada.
It had projected 1996 sales of more than 40 million stg and has grown by 20 to 30 percent a year since it started in 1982.
LucasVarity said the deal would give it a base for expansion in the North American independent aftermarket in components.
During last year's merger of Lucas Industries and Varity Corp the two firms said they aimed to strengthen their combined position in the automotive aftermarket sector.
The company has more than 400 customers throughout North America and also sells in Latin America, Europe and Asia. It employs about 300 people.

The business will operate within LucasVarity's aftermarket operations division. Autospecialty vice president and general manager Dino Crescentini will stay on in an executive role. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
